opcodes.name: ATSadd
opcodes.description: uses the data from an ATS analysis file to perform additive synthesis.
syntax: ar ATSadd ktimepnt, kfmod, iatsfile, ifn, ipartials[, ipartialoffset, \ ipartialincr, igatefn]

arguments.name: iatsfile
arguments.text: the ATS number (n in ats.n) or the name in quotes of the analysis file made using ATSA.

arguments.name: ifn
arguments.text: table number of a stored function containing a sine wave for ATSadd and a cosine for ATSaddnz (see examples below for more info)

arguments.name: ipartials
arguments.text: number of partials that will be used in the resynthesis (the noise has a maximum of 25 bands)

arguments.name: ipartialoffset
arguments.text: is the first partial used (defaults to 0).

arguments.name: ipartialincr
arguments.text: sets an increment by which these synthesis opcodes counts up from ipartialoffset for ibins components in the re-synthesis (defaults to 1).

arguments.name: igatefn
arguments.text: is the number of a stored function which will be applied to the amplitudes of the analysis bins before resynthesis takes place.

arguments.name: ktimepnt
arguments.text: The time pointer in seconds used to index the ATS file.

arguments.name: kfmod
arguments.text: A control-rate transposition factor: a value of 1 incurs no transposition, 1.5 transposes up a perfect fifth, and .5 down an octave.

opcodes.name: ATSaddnz
opcodes.description: uses the data from an ATS analysis file to perform noise resynthesis.
syntax: ar ATSaddnz ktimepnt, iatsfile, ibands[, ibandoffset, ibandincr]

arguments.name: iatsfile
arguments.text: the ATS number (n in ats.n) or the name in quotes of the analysis file made using ATSA.

arguments.name: ibands
arguments.text: number of noise bands that will be used in the resynthesis (the noise has a maximum of 25 bands)

arguments.name: ibandoffset
arguments.text: is the first noise band used (defaults to 0).

arguments.name: ibandincr
arguments.text: sets an increment by which these synthesis opcodes counts up from ibandoffset for ibins components in the re-synthesis (defaults to 1).

arguments.name: ktimepnt
arguments.text: The time pointer in seconds used to index the ATS file.

opcodes.name: ATSbufread
opcodes.description: reads data from and ATS data file and stores it in an internal data table of frequency, amplitude pairs.
syntax: ATSbufread ktimepnt, kfmod, iatsfile, ipartials[, ipartialoffset, \ ipartialincr]

arguments.name: iatsfile
arguments.text: the ATS number (n in ats.n) or the name in quotes of the analysis file made using ATSA.

arguments.name: ipartials
arguments.text: number of partials that will be used in the resynthesis (the noise has a maximum of 25 bands)

arguments.name: ipartialoffset
arguments.text: is the first partial used (defaults to 0).

arguments.name: ipartialincr
arguments.text: sets an increment by which these synthesis opcodes counts up from ipartialoffset for ibins components in the re-synthesis (defaults to 1).

arguments.name: ktimepnt
arguments.text: The time pointer in seconds used to index the ATS file.

arguments.name: kfmod
arguments.text: an input for performing pitch transposition or frequency modulation on all of the synthesized partials, if no fm or pitch change is desired then use a 1 for this value.

opcodes.name: ATScross
opcodes.description: perform cross synthesis from ATS analysis files.
syntax: ar ATScross ktimepnt, kfmod, iatsfile, ifn, kmylev, kbuflev, ipartials \ [, ipartialoffset, ipartialincr]

arguments.name: iatsfile
arguments.text: integer or character-string denoting a control-file derived from ATS analysis of an audio signal.

arguments.name: ifn
arguments.text: table number of a stored function containing a sine wave.

arguments.name: ipartials
arguments.text: number of partials that will be used in the resynthesis

arguments.name: ipartialoffset
arguments.text: is the first partial used (defaults to 0).

arguments.name: ipartialincr
arguments.text: sets an increment by which these synthesis opcodes counts up from ipartialoffset for ibins components in the re-synthesis (defaults to 1).

arguments.name: ktimepnt
arguments.text: The time pointer in seconds used to index the ATS file.

arguments.name: kfmod
arguments.text: an input for performing pitch transposition or frequency modulation on all of the synthesized partials, if no fm or pitch change is desired then use a 1 for this value.

arguments.name: kmylev
arguments.text: scales the ATScross component of the frequency spectrum applied to the partials from the ATS file indicated by the ATScross opcode.

opcodes.name: OSCbundle

syntax: OSCbundle kwhen, ihost, iport, Sdest[], Stype[],kArgs[][][,isize]

arguments.name: ihost
arguments.text: a string that is the intended host computer domain name.

arguments.name: iport
arguments.text: the number of the port that is used for the communication.

arguments.name: isize
arguments.text: maximum packet size in bytes, defaults to 65536.

arguments.name: kwhen
arguments.text: a bundle of messages is sent whenever this value changes.

arguments.name: Sdest[]
arguments.text: an array of strings containing the destination address for each message.

arguments.name: Stype[]
arguments.text: an array of strings containing the types for each message.

arguments.name: kArg[][]
arguments.text: a two-dimensional array containing the arguments for each message.

arguments.name: klen

arguments.name: idestination

opcodes.name: bbcutm
opcodes.description: Generates breakbeat-style cut-ups of a mono audio stream.
syntax: a1 bbcutm asource, ibps, isubdiv, ibarlength, iphrasebars, inumrepeats \ [, istutterspeed] [, istutterchance] [, ienvchoice ]

arguments.name: ibps
arguments.text: Tempo to cut at, in beats per second.

arguments.name: isubdiv
arguments.text: Subdivisions unit, for a bar.

arguments.name: ibarlength
arguments.text: How many beats per bar.

arguments.name: iphrasebars
arguments.text: The output cuts are generated in phrases, each phrase is up to iphrasebars long

arguments.name: inumrepeats
arguments.text: In normal use the algorithm would allow up to one additional repeat of a given cut at a time.

arguments.name: istutterspeed
arguments.text: (optional, default=1) The stutter can be an integer multiple of the subdivision speed.

arguments.name: istutterchance
arguments.text: (optional, default=0) The tail of a phrase has this chance of becoming a single repeating one unit cell stutter (0.0 to 1.0).

arguments.name: ienvchoice
arguments.text: (optional, default=1) choose 1 for on (exponential envelope for cut grains) or 0 for off.

arguments.name: asource
arguments.text: The audio signal to be cut up.

arguments.name: kpitch

arguments.name: klock

arguments.name: isize
arguments.text: table size.

arguments.name: igen
arguments.text: function table GEN routine.

arguments.name: iarray

opcodes.name: ftgentmp

arguments.name: igen

opcodes.name: grain2
opcodes.description: Easy-to-use granular synthesis texture generator.
syntax: ares grain2 kcps, kfmd, kgdur, iovrlp, kfn, iwfn [, irpow] \ [, iseed] [, imode]

arguments.name: iovrlp
arguments.text: (fixed) number of overlapping grains.

arguments.name: iwfn
arguments.text: function table containing window waveform (Use GEN20 to calculate iwfn).

arguments.name: irpow
arguments.text: this value controls the distribution of grain frequency variation.

arguments.name: iseed
arguments.text: seed value for random number generator (positive integer in the range 1 to 2147483646 (231 - 2)).

arguments.name: imode
arguments.text: sum of the following values: 8: interpolate window waveform (slower).
do not interpolate grain waveform (fast, but lower quality).
grain frequency is continuously modified by kcps and kfmd (by default, each grain keeps the frequency it was launched with).
skip initialization.

arguments.name: ares
arguments.text: output signal.

opcodes.name: grain3
opcodes.description: Generate granular synthesis textures with more user control.
syntax: ares grain3 kcps, kphs, kfmd, kpmd, kgdur, kdens, imaxovr, kfn, iwfn, \ kfrpow, kprpow [, iseed] [, imode]

arguments.name: imaxovr
arguments.text: maximum number of overlapping grains.

arguments.name: iwfn
arguments.text: function table containing window waveform (Use GEN20 to calculate iwfn).

arguments.name: iseed
arguments.text: seed value for random number generator (positive integer in the range 1 to 2147483646 (231 - 2)).

arguments.name: imode
arguments.text: sum of the following values: 64: synchronize start phase of grains to kcps.
start all grains at integer sample location.
do not render grains with start time less than zero.
interpolate window waveform (slower).
do not interpolate grain waveform (fast, but lower quality).

arguments.name: ares
arguments.text: output signal.

opcodes.name: granule
opcodes.description: A more complex granular synthesis texture generator.
syntax: ares granule xamp, ivoice, iratio, imode, ithd, ifn, ipshift, igskip, igskip_os, ilength, kgap, igap_os, kgsize, igsize_os, iatt, idec \ [, iseed] [, ipitch1] [, ipitch2] [, ipitch3] [, ipitch4] [, ifnenv]

arguments.name: ivoice

arguments.name: iratio
arguments.text: ratio of the speed of the gskip pointer relative to output audio sample rate.

arguments.name: ifn
arguments.text: function table number of sound source.

arguments.name: ipshift
arguments.text: pitch shift control.

arguments.name: igskip
arguments.text: initial skip from the beginning of the function table in sec.

arguments.name: igskip_os
arguments.text: gskip pointer random offset in sec, 0 will be no offset.

arguments.name: xamp
arguments.text: amplitude.

arguments.name: ksig
arguments.text: Output signal.

arguments.name: kfreq
arguments.text: Repeat rate in Hz or fraction of Hz.

arguments.name: ktrig
arguments.text: If non-zero, retriggers the envelope from start (see trigger opcode), before the envelope cycle is completed.

arguments.name: iphase
arguments.text: A value between 0 and 1 to say where to start the loop.

arguments.name: ktime0...ktimeN
arguments.text: Times of points; expressed in fraction of a cycle.

arguments.name: kvalue0...kvalueN
arguments.text: Values of points

opcodes.category: Signal Generators: Linear and Exponential Generators

opcodes.name: lorenz
opcodes.description: Implements the Lorenz system of equations.
syntax: ax, ay, az lorenz ksv, krv, kbv, kh, ix, iy, iz, iskip [, iskipinit]

arguments.name: ix
arguments.text: the initial coordinates of the particle.

arguments.name: iskip
arguments.text: used to skip generated values.

arguments.name: iskipinit
arguments.text: if non zero skip the initialisation of the filter.

arguments.name: ksv
arguments.text: the Prandtl number or sigma

arguments.name: krv
arguments.text: the Rayleigh number

arguments.name: kbv
arguments.text: the ratio of the length and width of the box in which the convection currents are generated

arguments.name: kh
arguments.text: the step size used in approximating the differential equation.

opcodes.name: lpcanal

arguments.name: isiz

arguments.name: ifilcod
arguments.text: integer or character-string denoting a control-file derived from pvanal analysis of an audio signal.

arguments.name: ifn
arguments.text: table number of a stored function containing a sine wave.

arguments.name: ibins
arguments.text: number of bins that will be used in the resynthesis (each bin counts as one oscillator in the re-synthesis)

arguments.name: ibinoffset
arguments.text: is the first bin used (it is optional and defaults to 0).

arguments.name: ibinincr
arguments.text: sets an increment by which pvadd counts up from ibinoffset for ibins components in the re-synthesis (see below for a further explanation).

arguments.name: iextractmode
arguments.text: determines if spectral extraction will be carried out and if so whether components that have changes in frequency below ifreqlim or above ifreqlim will be discarded.

arguments.name: igatefn
arguments.text: is the number of a stored function which will be applied to the amplitudes of the analysis bins before resynthesis takes place.

arguments.name: ktimpnt
arguments.text: and kfmod are used in the same way as in pvoc.

opcodes.name: pvbufread
opcodes.description: Reads from a phase vocoder analysis file and makes the retrieved data available.

arguments.name: ifile
arguments.text: the pvoc number (n in pvoc.n) or the name in quotes of the analysis file made using pvanal.

arguments.name: ktimpnt
arguments.text: the passage of time, in seconds, through this file.

opcodes.name: pvcross
opcodes.description: Applies the amplitudes from one phase vocoder analysis file to the data from a second file.
syntax: ares pvcross ktimpnt, kfmod, ifile, kampscale1, kampscale2 [, ispecwp]

arguments.name: ifile
arguments.text: the pvoc number (n in pvoc.n) or the name in quotes of the analysis file made using pvanal.

arguments.name: ispecwp
arguments.text: if non-zero, attempts to preserve the spectral envelope while its frequency content is varied by kfmod.

arguments.name: ktimpnt
arguments.text: the passage of time, in seconds, through this file.

arguments.name: kfmod
arguments.text: a control-rate transposition factor: a value of 1 incurs no transposition, 1.5 transposes up a perfect fifth, and 0.5 down an octave.

opcodes.name: pvinterp
opcodes.description: Interpolates between the amplitudes and frequencies of two phase vocoder analysis files.
syntax: ares pvinterp ktimpnt, kfmod, ifile, kfreqscale1, kfreqscale2, \ kampscale1, kampscale2, kfreqinterp, kampinterp

arguments.name: ifile
arguments.text: the pvoc number (n in pvoc.n) or the name in quotes of the analysis file made using pvanal.

arguments.name: ktimpnt
arguments.text: the passage of time, in seconds, through this file.

arguments.name: kfmod
arguments.text: a control-rate transposition factor: a value of 1 incurs no transposition, 1.5 transposes up a perfect fifth, and .5 down an octave.

arguments.name: kfreqscale1
arguments.text: used in pvinterp to scale the frequencies and amplitudes stored in each frame of the phase vocoder analysis file.

arguments.name: kfreqinterp
arguments.text: used in pvinterp, determine the interpolation distance between the values of one phase vocoder file and the values of a second file.

arguments.name: kampinterp
arguments.text: works in the same way upon the amplitudes of the two files.

arguments.name: igatefn

arguments.name: ktimpnt
arguments.text: The passage of time, in seconds, through the analysis file.

arguments.name: kfmod
arguments.text: a control-rate transposition factor: a value of 1 incurs no transposition, 1.5 transposes up a perfect fifth, and .5 down an octave.

opcodes.name: vco
opcodes.description: Implementation of a band limited, analog modeled oscillator.
syntax: ares vco xamp, xcps, iwave, kpw [, ifn] [, imaxd] [, ileak] [, inyx] \ [, iphs] [, iskip]

arguments.name: iwave
arguments.text: determines the waveform: iwave = 1 - sawtooth

arguments.name: ifn
arguments.text: Must point to a valid table which contains a sine wave.

arguments.name: imaxd
arguments.text: is the maximum delay time.

arguments.name: ileak
arguments.text: if ileak is between zero and one (0 < ileak < 1) then ileak is used as the leaky integrator value.

arguments.name: inyx
arguments.text: this is used to determine the number of harmonics in the band limited pulse.

arguments.name: iphs
arguments.text: this is a phase value.

arguments.name: iskip
arguments.text: if non zero skip the initialisation of the filter.

arguments.name: kpw
arguments.text: determines either the pulse width (if iwave is 2) or the saw/ramp character (if iwave is 3) The value of kpw should be greater than 0 and less than 1.

opcodes.name: vco2

arguments.name: kamp
arguments.text: amplitude scale.

arguments.name: kcps

arguments.name: kpw
arguments.text: the pulse width of the square wave (imode waveform=2) or the ramp characteristics of the triangle wave (imode waveform=4).

arguments.name: kphs
arguments.text: oscillator phase (depending on imode, this can be either an optional i-rate parameter that defaults to zero or required k-rate).

arguments.name: asig
arguments.text: the input of excitation noise

opcodes.name: window
opcodes.description: Applies a window to an array.

arguments.name: itype
arguments.text: optional window type: 0 = Hamming, 1 = Hanning (von Hann) (defaults to 1).

arguments.name: kout[]
arguments.text: output array containing the windowed output.

arguments.name: kin[]
arguments.text: input array containing the input vector.

arguments.name: koff
arguments.text: offset to make window start at position koff (non-negative only, defaults to 0).

opcodes.name: wrap
opcodes.description: Wraps-around the signal that exceeds the low and high thresholds.

arguments.text: input signal

arguments.name: ilow
arguments.text: low threshold

arguments.name: ihigh
arguments.text: high threshold

arguments.name: xsig
arguments.text: input signal

arguments.name: klow
arguments.text: low threshold

arguments.name: khigh
arguments.text: high threshold

opcodes.name: writescratch

opcodes.name: wterrain

opcodes.name: wterrain2
opcodes.description: A wave-terrain synthesis opcode using different curves

opcodes.name: xadsr
opcodes.description: Calculates the classical ADSR envelope.
syntax: ares xadsr iatt, idec, islev, irel [, idel]
kres xadsr iatt, idec, islev, irel [, idel]

arguments.name: iatt
arguments.text: duration of attack phase

arguments.name: idec
arguments.text: duration of decay

arguments.name: islev
arguments.text: level for sustain phase

arguments.name: irel
arguments.text: duration of release phase

arguments.name: idel
arguments.text: period of zero before the envelope starts

opcodes.name: xin
opcodes.description: Passes variables to a user-defined opcode block,

arguments.text: , xinarg2, ...

opcodes.name: xout
opcodes.description: Retrieves variables from a user-defined opcode block,

arguments.name: xoutarg1
arguments.text: , xoutarg2, ...

opcodes.name: xtratim
opcodes.description: Extend the duration of real-time generated events.

arguments.name: iextradur
arguments.text: additional duration of current instrument instance

opcodes.name: xyin
opcodes.description: Sense the cursor position in an output window
syntax: kx, ky xyin iprd, ixmin, ixmax, iymin, iymax [, ixinit] [, iyinit]

arguments.name: iprd
arguments.text: period of cursor sensing (in seconds).

opcodes.name: xyscale
opcodes.description: 2D linear interpolation
syntax: kout xyscale kx, ky, k00, k10, k01, k11

arguments.name: kx
arguments.text: Coordinates to evaluate the interpolation.

arguments.name: k00
arguments.text: Value of point at coord (x=0, y=0)

arguments.name: k10
arguments.text: Value of point at coord (x=1, y=0)

arguments.name: k01
arguments.text: Value of point at coord (x=0, y=1)

arguments.name: k11
arguments.text: Value of point at coord (x=1, y=1)

opcodes.category: Signal Generators: Linear and Exponential Generators

arguments.text: the number of locations to reserve for floats in the zk space.

opcodes.name: zar
opcodes.description: Reads from a location in za space at a-rate.

opcodes.name: zarg
opcodes.description: Reads from a location in za space at a-rate, adds some gain.

arguments.text: points to the za location to be read.

arguments.name: kgain
arguments.text: multiplier for the a-rate signal.

opcodes.name: zaw
opcodes.description: Writes to a za variable at a-rate without mixing.

arguments.name: asig
arguments.text: value to be written to the za location.

arguments.name: kndx
arguments.text: points to the za location to which to write.

opcodes.name: zawm
opcodes.description: Writes to a za variable at a-rate with mixing.

arguments.name: imix
arguments.text: indicates if mixing should occur.

arguments.name: asig
arguments.text: value to be written to the za location.

arguments.name: kndx
arguments.text: points to the za location to which to write.

arguments.name: Caution
arguments.text: : When using the mixing opcodes ziwm, zkwm, and zawm, care must be taken that the variables mixed to, are zeroed at the end (or start) of each k- or a-cycle.
